_comment: Movement seed for every scenario (tools/build-scenarios.mjs movementRun): field elevations (ft), normal departures/hr per airport (default 30), departures now vs normal (mult; arrivals multArr), airports still learning, and airline hub counts {CODE: {hubs: {IATA: normal dep/hr}, now: share of normal over the last 2 hours}}. Scenarios override keys in their own movement.json.
